Pillar 4 render-review board — 5 slide archetypes (cover flat/radial, divider, content light/dark); operator approved the grammar + chose radial-heroes/flat-content 2026-06-19

principles: Substance before style — the work speaks; decoration must earn its place.
Orchestration as metaphor — every layout, motif, and typographic choice encodes disparate parts resolved into one coherent system.
Editorial restraint — spacious layouts, measured type scales, ink-and-paper contrast; no visual noise.
Signal economy — indigo is a signal colour, never a flood; a single focal dot carries the accent.
The score made visible — concentric dot-fields and barline rhythm render orchestration as a structural system, not a picture of instruments.
signatureElements: Dot-dome — the primary mark: a polar lattice of dots forming an orchestra dome with one indigo focal dot at the podium; the rising-ensemble signature.
Concentric dot-field — rings of dots radiating from a single indigo focal; full-bleed texture for heroes and dividers; drives the field-breathe motion.
Barline measure — abstract vertical barlines with beat-dots and one indigo accent beat; rhythm and structure motif for footers, rails, and content grids.
Misaligned numeral — large Fraunces section numbers split cream/indigo with a deliberate baseline offset; the 'scored' editorial cue.
Space Grotesk wordmark — STROMY set in Space Grotesk 600 with open tracking, rising from the dot-dome; primary identity lockup.
Misaligned secondary lockup — the 'scored' STROMY wordmark for cover slides, home-page heroes, and section openers.
antiPatterns: No literal musical notation — no staves, clefs, or noteheads; orchestration is rendered through abstract dots, not sheet music.
No orange or Claude-adjacent accent — indigo (#61009E) is the only signal colour; the retired oxide/orange must not reappear.
No gradient floods on working surfaces — the stage-light radial is a hero-only device; content and document backgrounds stay flat.
No decorative motif scatter — the dot family is assigned by role (dome=identity, field=texture, barline=rhythm), never sprinkled for taste.
No pure-white document grounds where Cream is specified; no stock-office or AI-futurism imagery.
Never more than one indigo focal dot in a single composition — the signal is singular.

spec.default: dark-light-indexed — Concert Black heroes/dividers alternate with Cream/White content
hall-immersion — Concert Black sustained across hero + section opens; Cream reserved for dense reading spreads. Same surfaces, a darker, more immersive rhythm.
cream-forward — Cream/White carry the deck; Concert Black punctuates covers + dividers only. Same surfaces, a lighter, editorial rhythm.

spec.borders: 1-1.5px hairline rules in thistle/ink at low opacity; depth via colour not shadow

behaviors.name: dome-assemble
behaviors.desc: the dot-dome composes itself ring by ring; the indigo focal lands at the podium and settles (no bounce) — 'the orchestra composes itself'

behaviors.name: barline-reveal
behaviors.desc: barlines and beat-dots reveal left-to-right in measure order; the indigo accent beat keys last

behaviors.name: field-breathe
behaviors.desc: the concentric dot-field breathes (subtle scale/opacity pulse); the indigo focal pulses gently at the centre

spec.note: Behaviors co-created + operator-approved for this brand (justified deviation from the generic 'reserve motion until P6' rule — these are real approved decisions, not a silent drop). Bake/render_video productionization owned by Pillar 6 (brand-artifact-builder / render_motion).

treatments.note: Named brand 'house looks' applied to photography DOWNSTREAM (format-MCP render + website CSS) — never pre-baked into the shipped library. Restrained: one clean base image x the treatment = flexible reuse. ORG-PLAN-045.

nocturne.label: Nocturne
nocturne.usage: Editorial monochrome + fine grain — the timeless default for dividers, quotes, and dense content backgrounds.

velvet-tritone.label: Velvet Tritone
velvet-tritone.usage: Signature deep-amethyst wash for covers + hero moments — applied transparently (rich dark-amethyst shadows through amethyst mids to soft thistle highlights, low strength so the photo breathes). A rich purple hue, kept subtle.

amethyst-splittone.label: Amethyst Split-tone
amethyst-splittone.usage: Subtle cinematic grade for backgrounds + section imagery — mostly neutral, a whisper of amethyst in shadows and warm cream in highlights. The restrained default.

spotlight-noir.label: Spotlight Noir
spotlight-noir.usage: B&W with a soft radial vignette (echoes the concert spotlight) + grain — focal hero treatment that draws the eye.
